zh.title: David Cummins宣誓就任美國運輸安全管理局第八任局長
zh.summary: 美國參議院通過確認案後，David Cummins已正式宣誓就任美國運輸安全管理局（TSA）第八任局長。他在2026年5月獲美國總統川普提名，將領導約6萬名員工，負責全美430多座機場及鐵路、管道與海運等陸上交通系統的安全監管作業。
body: 根據AeroTime報導，經美國參議院確認通過後，David Cummins已正式宣誓就任美國運輸安全管理局（TSA）第八任局長。美國總統川普於2026年5月提名Cummins出任該職，負責領導約6萬名員工，並監管全美430多座機場的安檢作業。
除了航空安全外，Cummins亦將負責包括鐵路、大眾運輸、公路、管道與海運等陸上交通系統的安全工作。Cummins表示，未來將著重於TSA員工團隊建設、提升士氣，並在安檢站導入新型技術。他此前曾擔任2002年鹽湖城冬季奧運會營運管理總監，並曾在民營交通領域工作。

en.title: David Cummins Sworn In as Eighth TSA Administrator Following Senate Confirmation
en.summary: David Cummins has been sworn in as the eighth Administrator of the Transportation Security Administration (TSA) following his confirmation by the US Senate. Nominated by US President Donald Trump in May 2026, Cummins takes charge of an agency with around 60,000 employees. In his new role, he will oversee security operations at more than 430 airports across the United States, as well as surface transportation sectors including rail, mass transit, highways, pipelines, and maritime networks. Cummins stated that he plans to focus on the TSA workforce, improving employee morale, and deploying advanced technology at security checkpoints.
body: David Cummins has been sworn in as the eighth Administrator of the Transportation Security Administration (TSA) following his confirmation by the US Senate. Nominated by US President Donald Trump in May 2026, Cummins will lead a workforce of approximately 60,000 employees and oversee security operations across more than 430 airports in the nation.

In addition to aviation security, Cummins will be responsible for surface transportation security, including rail, mass transit systems, highways, pipelines, and maritime infrastructure. Cummins stated that he will focus on supporting the TSA workforce, improving employee morale, and rolling out new technology at security checkpoints. Prior to his appointment, he served as Director of Operations Management for the 2002 Winter Olympics in Salt Lake City and worked in the private transportation sector.

zh.title: IndiGo將以空中巴士A321XLR執飛孟買阿姆斯特丹11小時航線
zh.summary: IndiGo（印度靛藍航空）確認與 Norse Atlantic Airways 的波音 787-9 濕租協議將於 2026 年 10 月底結束，屆時將調派 195 座空中巴士 A321XLR 執飛孟買至阿姆斯特丹航線，單程飛行時間最長達 11 小時。此舉旨在維持史基浦機場時段，並過渡至 2028 年接收空中巴士 A350-900 機隊。此外，Willie Walsh 已於 8 月 3 日正式就任該公司執行長。
body: IndiGo（印度靛藍航空）即將在印度孟買至荷蘭阿姆斯特丹的直飛航線上部署空中巴士 A321XLR 單通道客機，其單程飛行區塊時間最長將達 11 小時。這項部署計畫是在 IndiGo 確認與 Norse Atlantic Airways 的波音 787-9 濕租合約將於 2026 年 10 月底結束後所做出的調整。該航線由 A321XLR 接替原本營運的波音 787-9 機隊，成為全球預計排定航程最長的空中巴士 A321XLR 直飛服務。
根據規劃，該航線由孟買飛往阿姆斯特丹的去程區塊時間最長為 11 小時，回程則約為 9 小時 40 分鐘。受限於當前地緣政治與空域限制，飛機無法行經巴基斯坦、伊朗及俄羅斯部分空域的最短航路，而必須繞道沙烏地阿拉伯與埃及。此繞行航路使總飛行距離增加約 14%，進一步增加了飛行時間與燃油消耗。IndiGo 將在此航線上採用 195 座配置的 A321XLR 機型執飛。
保留阿姆斯特丹史基浦機場的起降時段對 IndiGo 的歐洲網路佈局至關重要。作為新進入該機場的航空公司，依據史基浦機場的時段規範，IndiGo 必須維持至少 80% 的配額航班營運，否則將面臨失去時段的風險。因此，IndiGo 規劃以 A321XLR 客機填補過渡期，直到預計於 2028 年開始交付的空中巴士 A350-900 廣體客機陸續投入服務為止。
此一網路策略調整之際，IndiGo 正迎來高層人事更迭。Willie Walsh 於 8 月 3 日正式接任 IndiGo 執行長，接替先前領導該公司拓展國際市場與訂購長程機隊的 Pieter Elbers。Willie Walsh 過去曾擔任國際航空運輸協會理事長，並曾領導國際航空集團、英國航空及愛爾蘭航空。

en.title: IndiGo to Deploy Airbus A321XLR on 11-Hour Mumbai-Amsterdam Route
en.summary: IndiGo plans to deploy its 195-seat Airbus A321XLR aircraft on the nonstop Mumbai-Amsterdam route after its damp lease for Boeing 787-9 aircraft with Norse Atlantic Airways ends in late October 2026. The flight will feature a block time of up to 11 hours, making it the longest scheduled A321XLR route. The temporary narrowbody service will help IndiGo preserve its slots at Amsterdam Airport Schiphol until deliveries of its Airbus A350-900 fleet commence in 2028. Separately, Willie Walsh formally took charge as IndiGo chief executive officer on August 3, succeeding Pieter Elbers.
body: IndiGo is preparing to deploy its Airbus A321XLR narrowbody aircraft on non-stop flights between Mumbai and Amsterdam, with block times scheduled for up to 11 hours outbound. The fleet operational shift comes after the Indian carrier confirmed that its damp lease agreement with Norse Atlantic Airways for Boeing 787-9 aircraft will conclude at the end of October 2026. The 195-seat A321XLR will temporarily replace the leased Boeing widebody jets on the European route.

The scheduled daily service features a block time of up to 11 hours on the Mumbai-to-Amsterdam sector and approximately nine hours and 40 minutes on the return segment, making it the longest planned non-stop Airbus A321XLR operation globally. Due to geopolitical airspace restrictions avoiding Pakistan, Iran, and portions of Russia, the flight must follow a longer routing through Saudi Arabia and Egypt. This detour increases the flight distance by about 14 percent, adding to flight times and operational fuel consumption.

Retaining access at Amsterdam Airport Schiphol remains a key strategic priority for IndiGo's long-haul network development. Having secured slots at Schiphol as a new entrant, the airline must operate at least 80 percent of its allocated capacity under airport slot regulations to avoid forfeiting them. Deploying the A321XLR allows IndiGo to maintain continuous service on the route and safeguard its slots until deliveries of its ordered Airbus A350-900 fleet begin in 2028.

The long-haul operational strategy coincides with a leadership succession at India's largest carrier. Willie Walsh officially assumed the role of chief executive officer at IndiGo on 3 August, succeeding Pieter Elbers, who had overseen the airline's initial international expansion and long-range aircraft commitments. Walsh previously served as Director General of the International Air Transport Association and led International Airlines Group, British Airways, and Aer Lingus.
